text:
maria.marketing: Quick / last-minute ask — launch tomorrow morning. Can runtime do a small resweep and a sanity validation on the quantized variant we plan to cite? Need: n=150 samples, model=redwood-3b-quant-q4, warmup=3, seed=42, include token-level timing + p50/p95/p99. Also saw a weird tail in last run (trace b2f3) — please surface any root cause clues and raw sample ids.

sam.runtime: We can do a quick resweep on staging. Timeline ~2–3h if we queue tonight. Do you want full coldstart+warm caches?

maria.marketing: Both — coldstart AND warm cache. Coldstart is priority for the customer-facing claim. Tag me if p99 > 800ms.

josh.runtime: I can pick this up on staging-dedicated-5 tonight. Will run: quant-q4 binary + our standard warmup script. Need an exact payload file and confirmation on batching config (we used batch_size=8 last time).

maria.marketing: Use batch_size=8 to match slides. Payload: use marketing_prompt_set_v3.json (public-demo cohort). I'll upload in a sec.

anna.eng: Heads-up — I'll validate the warmup policy and KV cache handling. Recommend we capture both prefix-KV hit rate and raw KV sizes in traces. Also include one run with prefix caching disabled to reproduce the tail.

benchbot: Job queued: job-87912 started on staging-dedicated-5. Command: `./bench_runner --cohort marketing_prompt_set_v3.json --model redwood-3b-quant-q4 --seed 42 --warmup 3 --batch 8 --out s3://redwood-staging/bench/job-87912`

sam.runtime: Please dump token-level CSV (token, latency_ms) and a summary JSON with percentiles. Stick to the labeling convention: `cohort/seed/model/warmup`.

josh.runtime: Running now. ETA ~1.5h. I will post: s3://redwood-staging/bench/job-87912/artifacts.zip and a short findings snippet. If we detect p99 > 2s for any slice, we'll mark `fail/marketing-hold` and ping product.

maria.marketing: Copy — if fail, hold the social push and inform PM @kyle.prod. Also please include raw sample ids so we can independently review the few slow examples.

anna.eng: Also including reproduce command and env notes in the artifact: ```bash
# reproduce locally
./run_bench --cohort marketing_prompt_set_v3.json --seed 42 --model redwood-3b-quant-q4 --warmup 3 --batch 8
# env: staging-dedicated-5, runtime v2.4.1, kernel opt A
```

josh.runtime: Posted interim note: artifacts uploading now. Short top-5 slow traces: trace b2f3 (same as before) shows long KV fetch at token 34, trace c3d9 had a large prompt leading to cache eviction. Full artifacts: s3://redwood-staging/bench/job-87912/artifacts.zip

sam.runtime: Preliminary numbers: p50=82ms, p95=360ms, p99=760ms (quant-q4, warm cache). Coldstart p99=1.9s (we flagged two outliers). Attaching CSV and percentile JSON in the artifact bundle.

maria.marketing: Thanks — this is super helpful. Two asks: 1) create a one-paragraph summary we can paste in the release notes that calls out the warm vs cold p99s and the two slow traces, 2) include a tiny anonymized excerpt (prompt id + latency, no user text) for comms.

josh.runtime: Will add a 3-4 line summary and anonymized sample ids in `summary.md` inside the artifact.

maria.marketing: :thumbsup: If everything stays within the current thresholds we'll proceed with the scheduled social + webinar mention. If anything changes, please ping the channel immediately.

sam.runtime: Noted. I'll keep monitoring the upload and add a short regression checklist in the artifact (what to rerun, delta thresholds, hotfix guidance).

maria.marketing: Appreciate it — love how you all move fast.

benchbot: Job completed: job-87912 finished. Artifacts: s3://redwood-staging/bench/job-87912/artifacts.zip, summary at s3://redwood-staging/bench/job-87912/summary.md

josh.runtime: Done — summary.md includes: short findings, p50/p95/p99, the two flagged trace ids, reproduce command, and a recommended follow-up (rerun with different kernel A/B on the two outliers).

maria.marketing: Perfect. I'll draft the 1-paragraph claim and share for quick review. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
